item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate today. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong later on Friday. It will be rather cool and windy over the region during the weekend and early next week. The weather will remain fine over the region during midweek next week and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
